name: Tooth Fairy Swarm

items.name: Plaque Burst
items.text: When killed, a tooth fairy swarm bursts into sticky, foul-smelling white dust. Each creature in a 15-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save save or become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

items.name: Pinch
items.text: Tooth fairies pinch their victims' fingers, noses, ears, or similar protruding body parts. Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). Creatures that critically fail this save are Sickened 1 from the pain.

items.name: Pry
items.text:
The tooth fairies try to pry out one of their target's teeth. One enemy in the swarm's space takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage with a DC 20 basic Reflex save save. On a failed save, the target takes 2 bleed damage and loses a tooth.

If the creature loses a tooth, it takes a –1 status penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and must succeed at a DC 5 Flat check to Cast a Spell unless that spell has the subtle trait. These effects last for 1 day, or until the stolen tooth is returned and the target regains at least 1 Hit Point.

Effect: Tooth Tug

text:
A mob of tooth fairies working together can conduct forced dentistry in seconds.

---

Tooth fairies spawn when a child's tooth (or, less commonly, an entire child) is buried in terrain rife with fey energies. Hatching from the buried teeth like larvae from an egg, tooth fairies build crude pliers from whatever they can find, then go hunting for more teeth—regardless of the owners' willingness.
